title: Define infrastructure trust-zone and provider-neutral port contracts
businessObjective: Keep guest operations isolated while future Staff and AI OS infrastructure can change without a domain rewrite.
technicalObjective: Define finite static V1 contracts for public/staff/AI trust zones, authenticated audience-bound short-lived cross-account HTTPS integration with replay resistance and idempotency, and provider-neutral inbound/outbound ports; do not provision infrastructure.
assumptions: No account, domain, credential, service, deployment, or production integration is selected or accessed.
acceptanceCriteria: Contracts distinguish guest/public, staff/control, and AI/workload zones with separate credentials, quotas, deployments, and failure boundaries.

Cross-account use is limited to bounded HTTPS calls authenticated by audience-bound short-lived credentials; recipient validation rejects missing/expired/mis-audienced credentials, bad timestamps, reused nonces, replay, malformed bodies, and over-limit calls before dispatch.

The contract fixes nonce/timestamp/replay-rejection and idempotency semantics, bounded request/response bodies and timeouts, and per-authenticated-caller/per-route rate limits; retries may not duplicate an accepted operation.
Small stable ports cover persistence, ingestion, analytics, scheduling/queues, workflow, object storage, notifications, intelligence, deployment, and authentication.
Core/domain dependency rules prohibit Cloudflare, Supabase, GitHub, OpenAI, LINE, and local-server SDK imports.

Negative tests reject unauthenticated exposure, audience confusion, replay, duplicate idempotency use, unbounded body/timeout, route/caller rate-limit bypass, shared booking/AI boundary, provider authority, and unsupported ports.
requiredChecks: exact validator admission before independent verification
solEscalationTriggers: Any provider/account selection, live integration, authentication weakening, public exposure, or change to booking availability boundaries.
rollbackExpectations: Revert only the contract implementation and preserve evidence; no external state exists.

stateTransitions.reason: Created by GOV-043 for the required infrastructure authority.
